instruction: The opened file `orig.PCBDwf` is an Altium Draftsman template in INI-style text format with sections `[Header]`, `[Sheet]`, `[TitleBlock]`, `[ViewsReferences]`, and `[BoardRealism]`. `C:\Users\user\Desktop\mods.json` defines the required edits. Produce `C:\Users\user\Desktop\custom.PCBDwf` with these three modifications: 1. In section `[Sheet]`, change `SheetSize` to `mods.json.sheet_size` (`A3L`) and leave all other keys unchanged. 2. In section `[TitleBlock]`, change `Company` to `mods.json.company_name` (`NewCorp Electronics Ltd.`) and leave the other keys (`Address`, `Phone`) unchanged. 3. Append a new section `[DrillTable]` to the end of the file, writing the 6 key-value pairs from dictionary `mods.json.drill_table_section` (`TableName`, `LinkedView`, `SortOrder`, `ShowPlated`, `ShowNonPlated`, `ColumnCount`) in their original order. Keep sections `[Header]`, `[ViewsReferences]`, and `[BoardRealism]` unchanged. Use UTF-8 without BOM and CRLF line endings.
